description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Submits the finished onboarding (or a corrected business after rejection) for review. A new location of a live business, by an owner Awning already knows, goes live at once: report the returned status as it is. Confirm with the owner first. Use it once, after owner_preview and the owner's yes; to change a live business use the owner_update_* tools instead.

business_id.description: Which business, when the owner runs several: business_id from owner_status. Leave out when there is only one.

draft_id.description: The setup to send: its draft_id from owner_setup. For a corrected business after a rejection pass business_id instead.

name: owner_submit
title: Submit application to Awning
